entities.name: Makare
entities.description: An Amonkheti human who fell during the Final Hours and became an Eternal; she killed her love Genub, later joined the Dreadhorde and was re-killed by Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Genub
entities.description: Makare's forbidden love, struck down by her after she became an Eternal.

entities.name: Spellweaver Eternal
entities.description: An Eternal whose spells felled Makare and raised her as an Eternal.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler of Amonkhet whom Makare and Genub defied.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: The final period on Amonkhet during which Makare fell.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The hour during which Makare and Genub stuck together.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: The Phyrexian-style horde on Ravnica that Makare became part of.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya world-tree city that re-killed Makare.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Makare was re-killed.

events.summary: Makare and Genub, who pledged forbidden love defying the God-Pharaoh, are separated in an attack by a Spellweaver Eternal.
events.quote: They stuck together during the Hour of Eternity

events.summary: Makare falls to the Spellweaver Eternal's spells and is raised as an Eternal.
events.quote: She fell to its spells and was risen as an Eternal

events.summary: When Genub reaches her, Makare strikes him down.
events.quote: As Genub reached her, she struck him down

events.summary: Makare becomes part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and is re-killed by Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica

relations.quote: Makare had pledged her forbidden love to Genub

relations.note: She struck him down after becoming an Eternal.
relations.quote: As Genub reached her, she struck him down

relations.note: She became part of the Dreadhorde.
relations.quote: She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica
